title: the son montuno folds the fractal on every hit, the set changes shape at 2415
story: Amor Adolescente at 95.7 BPM (tracker beat 20 ticks) plays a son montuno: onsets fire on nearly every 16th, so the picture follows the strong ones by class. Bright strokes fold the set (pliegue 0 to 0.6), dark open tones mute the saturation (1.0 to 0.5) and mid hits push saturation (1.0 to 1.5), while zoom#2 slowly pushes into the build until the section change at 2415 (slope 11.3). There the Julia shape nudges over one bar, the hue steps to -0.08, contrast opens, and the sway continues every two beats on the warm tropical-sunset palette. The four prominent hits (1934, 2027, 2790, 2799) fold, shake and flash together.
